main_text.p: ut [illegible, ~3 letters] pîr fenex : aliquando verò sepa-rantur.

Aliquando etiam duo illa puncta in unam curvam lineam extenduntur, quod & in [illegible, ~1 letter] & reliquis punctatis sæpè accidit: [illegible, ~1 letter] & [illegible, ~1 letter] sæpè in curvam lineam exten-duntur, & tria puncta in [illegible, ~1 letter] sæpè in lineo-lam etiam convertuntur.
Magna est discrepantia in pronuntiatione literarum [illegible, ~8 letters] inter Europæos & Orientales ; ex Tabella tamen vera pronuntiatio aliquatenus intelli-gi potest.

Literæ [illegible, ~4 letters] à Persis vulgò efferuntur, ut z apud nos : Ideoque in Pentateucho Persico Constantinopoli à Judæis edito, eas omnes per ץ[?] Hebræum exprimit Tawafius : at [illegible, ~1 letter] paulò fortius quasi zh, vel tz pronuntiatur.
[illegible, ~1 letter] Ghaf Persicum (nam sine punctis [illegible, ~1 letter], Kaf Arabicum dicitur) à Turcis pronunti-atur.

page.notes: Arabic letters are not transcribed; each is marked illegible because the scan is too small to read them reliably. The Hebrew letter after "per" is a doubtful reading (ץ[?]). The "Tawafius" spelling and "Hebræum" are as far as the scan allows. No running head, catchword or signature is printed.
